desc.zh: 用逐位匹配排除候选，再用最坏回复桶选择提问。
desc.en: Filter by positional matches and choose guesses by worst reply buckets.

complexity: O(n²L + Gn²) time; O(n²) auxiliary space, L=6 and G≤10

concepts.name: Candidate consistency
concepts.description: Filter the words by exact agreement with every reply.

concepts.name: Worst reply bucket
concepts.description: Minimize the largest non-success reply group.
